Container.Name: Cellarly
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted wine cellar manager. Every bottle lives at an exact row and position in a rack you can spin around in 3D, on a server that is entirely yours.
Search a wine catalog or snap a photo of the label, track what you paid and what it is worth, rate what you drink and watch the drink-window countdown. Share one server with your household, in German or English.
Everything is stored in one SQLite file in the appdata folder, backed up daily and before every upgrade, and downloadable and restorable from the Admin page. Google Gemini (optional API key) powers label recognition, enrichment and the price and critics lookup.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The SQLite database and its automatic backups. This is the only state the app has.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Signs and encrypts the session cookie. At least 32 random characters, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it stable: changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account. Needed once, when the first start creates it; changing it later has no effect.

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: Email the admin signs in with. Read on the first start only.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Leave at false while you open the app over plain http://. Browsers drop a secure cookie over HTTP and login then silently fails. Set to true once the app is reached over HTTPS.

Config.Name: Gemini API key
Config.Description: Optional. Google Gemini key for label recognition, enrichment and the price and critics lookup (the lookup needs a paid key).

Config.Name: Daily backups kept
Config.Description: How many daily backups of the database to keep in the backups folder. 0 switches them off. Backups taken before an upgrade or a restore are never deleted.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is believed, comma-separated addresses or ranges. For Nginx Proxy Manager on the default bridge: 172.17.0.0/16.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional. Together with SMTP from and SMTP public URL it switches on password-reset mails; without them an admin issues a temporary password instead.

Config.Name: SMTP from
Config.Description: Sender address of the password-reset mail.

Config.Name: SMTP public URL
Config.Description: Address the reset link points to, e.g. https://cellarly.example.com

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 with SMTP secure on.

Config.Name: SMTP secure
Config.Description: true means TLS from the first byte (port 465). Leave empty for STARTTLS.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: Only for relays that ask for a login.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Only for relays that ask for a login.
